notes.title: Eggstraction Update notes for 31st of March 2025
notes.content:
This patch adds support for Xbox controllers throughout all menus in the game. It also fixes some small bugs that have been reported by our community.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added full Xbox controller support to all menus.
[/list]

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added remaining translations for Brazilian Portuguese, French, Spanish, Polish, Japanese, German, Chinese, Russian and Turkish.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Farmer traps being triggered through walls
[*] Fixed a rare issue where chickens could fall under the map
[*] Fixed an issue with sending empty chat messages
[*] Fixed a rare crash when a farmer would grab a chicken as they closed the game
[/list]

Join our discord to hear about the upcoming egg-citing new content!

Thanks,
TwoShoedLou

notes.title: Eggstraction Update notes for 10th of August 2024
notes.content:
This patch addresses some bugs reported by the community and also adds better support for multiple languages. This is a small update whilst we work towards some more content for the game. 

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more translations for Brazilian Portuguese, French, Spanish, Polish, Japanese, German, Chinese, Russian and Turkish.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed farmer input getting locked if held chicken quits.
[*] Fixed multiple locations on the ground floor of the farm and house where the chickens could get stuck.
[*] Fixed issue where empty chat messages would be sent in the lobby.
[*] Fixed a crash for those with SteamVR installed.
[/list]

Join our discord to hear about when the new content update may be about to hatch!

Thanks,
TwoShoedLou

notes.title: Eggstraction Update notes for 18th of June 2024
notes.content:
In this patch we have added some requested features from the community and made a few quality of life improvements alongside the usual bug fixes.

Balance Changes
[list]
[*]Decreased time to release chickens.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where players could sometimes join full lobbies.
[*]Fixed range of releasing chicken sound.
[*]Slight performance improvements to shadows.
[/list]


If you have suggestions for new features, find any bugs or have feedback on the game, please post them in our Discord or leave a Steam Review!

Thank you,
TwoShoedLou

notes.title: Eggstraction Update notes for 15th of June 2024
notes.content:
In this patch we have added some requested features from the community and made a few quality of life improvements alongside the usual bug fixes.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new Key Bindings so you can now change your controls.
[*]Added Invert Mouse option.
[*]Added a sound for releasing chickens.
[*]Added more time options to when hosting a game.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased the farmers shotgun range.
[*]Improved hit detection for farmers shotgun.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where a player leaving the lobby would not stop the countdown.
[*]Fixed issue where sending a message in lobby would deselect the message box.
[*]Fixed issue where language changes were not persistent.
[*]Potential fix for rare issue where players with high ping could fail to respawn.
[/list]

If you have suggestions for new features, find any bugs or have feedback on the game, please post them in our Discord or leave a Steam Review!

Thank you,
TwoShoedLou

notes.title: Eggstraction Update notes for 20th of May 2024
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has been playing and providing us with great suggestions and feedback. We have a bigger patch on the way but this one addresses some of the more important bugs that you have reported.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Chickens can no longer be hit by the bear trap when in the cage.
[*]Cage (the chicken) can no longer escape the cage.
[*]Fixed issue where players would fall through the floor after jumping in the cage.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Can now see "In Progress" games in the server browser.
[*]Farmer traps are now slightly larger.
[*]Added more translations for Brazilian Portuguese.
[/list]

If you find any bugs please post them in our Discord or if you have suggestions on how to improve the game please leave us a review!

Thanks,
TwoShoedLou

notes.title: We want your feedback!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We want to hear what you have to say about the game. 

Any suggestions you have to improve the game or if you just want to share your opinion on it, please leave us a [b]steam review[/b]. Each review helps us to better the experience for all our players and we will read every piece of feedback and try to address as much as possible in future updates.

Thanks,
TwoShoedLou

notes.title: Eggstraction Update notes for 18th of May 2024
notes.content:
We have listening to all of the excellent feedback you have given us in our Discord and have addressed a few major issues in this update.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]When a player disconnects or is kicked the game will no longer be stuck at [b]00:00.[/b]
[*]The server browser will now show the correct number of players in a lobby.
[*]You should no longer be able to join a full server.
[*]The Farmer can no longer place traps directly on the coop.
[*]Rescued chickens will now spawn on top of the cage instead of in front of it.
[/list]

If you find any bugs please post them in our Discord or if you have suggestions on how to improve the game please leave us a review!

notes.title: Launch Day Patch
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played the game so far. We have really enjoyed watching the streams and have been listening to the feedback from the community.

This patch is focused on fixing some small bugs and tweaking the balancing slightly.

[h2]Balance tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]The farmer can now [b]see the locations of eggs before the round[/b] starts, this should allow him to place his defences accordingly.
[*]The farmer's shotgun range has been increased from 400 to [b]500[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Frank's Rocket can no longer stun the farmer if he is in the cage.
[*]Fixed a bug where players could join full lobbies.
[*]Fixed a bug with the lights on eggs only showing at a certain range.
[/list]

If you find any bugs or have suggestions on how to improve the game please reach out at:
twoshoedgames@gmail.com
